description: Aggregate recent results into averages, best score, trend and mode/language breakdown. Cheaper than fetching raw results and doing the math yourself.

language.description: Language id from Monkeytype, e.g. english, english_1k, spanish, german, french.

limit.description: How many recent results to analyse. Defaults to 50.

mode.description: Typing mode: time, words, quote, custom or zen.

onOrAfterTimestamp.description: Only analyse results at or after this Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

name: analyze_results
title: Analyze recent results
